designIntent: replace the generic pointed-roof medieval guardhouse silhouette with a compact Roman legion barracks
keep the stable runtime 2x2 footprint while changing only the authored LV2 visual model

romanStructure: exactly one low connected rectangular stone-and-plaster barracks hall
one complete flat stone roof deck with low continuous side and rear parapets
exactly two attached symmetric flat-topped square corner towers
one connected crenellated front curtain wall
one centered arched gatehouse with a visible dark portal
complete broad battlement groups on the towers, curtain and gatehouse
exactly two tower-mounted crimson Roman legion standards
exactly two tower-mounted crimson scuta with aged-brass fittings
all structural components remain inside the original 2x2 foundation
styleContract: weathered limestone and darker fieldstone with warm earth mineral plaster
flat weathered stone roof edging, dark oak, blackened iron and naturally aged brass
deep crimson flags and shields form the single restrained military accent family
no readable Latin text, numerals, runes or modern national insignia
negativeConstraints: no pitched roof, gable roof, red tiled roof, pointed tower roof, conical turret, Gothic spire or half-timber facade
no third tower, second hall, second roof, detached wall or expanded courtyard
no temple, palace, amphitheater, aqueduct or giant colonnade
no siege engine, ballista, catapult, vehicle or modern machinery
no soldiers, hamsters, people, animals, loose weapons or extra flags
no readable text, oversized foundation, neon or sci-fi machinery
